lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gur paaiaa bhaaee har har naam dhiaai ||3||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I found the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sadaa hai niramalaa bhaaee niramal saache soi ||
lines.translation: The Truth is forever pure, O Siblings of Destiny; those who are true are pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee bhaaee tis paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, O Siblings of Destiny, then one obtains Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot madhe jan paaeeai bhaaee viralaa koee koi ||
lines.translation: Among millions, O Siblings of Destiny, hardly one humble servant of the Lord is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rataa sach naam bhaaee sun man tan niramal hoi ||4||2||
lines.translation: Nanak is imbued with the True Name, O Siblings of Destiny; hearing it, the mind and body become immaculately pure. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 dutuke ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਭਾਉ ਅਭਾਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau lau bhaau abhaau ihu maanai tau lau milan dooraaee ||
lines.translation: As long as this person believes in love and hate, it is difficult for him to meet the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬੀਚੁ ਬਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan aapanaa karat beechaaraa tau lau beech bikhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: As long as he discriminates between himself and others, he will distance himself from the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਐਸੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhave aisee dehu bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, grant me such understanding,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਗਹਉ ਓਟ ਚਰਨਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevau saadh gahau ot charanaa nah bisarai muhat chasaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: that I might serve the Holy Saints, and seek the protection of their feet, and not forget them, for a moment, even an instant. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਐਸੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man mugadh achet cha(n)chal chit tum aisee ridai na aaee ||
lines.translation: O foolish, thoughtless and fickle mind, such understanding did not come into your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਤੂ ਰਚਿਆ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: praanapat tiaag aan too rachiaa urajhio sa(n)g bairaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Renouncing the Lord of Life, you have become engrossed in other things, and you are involved with your enemies. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਥਾਪੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sog na biaapai aap na thaapai saadhasa(n)gat budh paaee ||
lines.translation: Sorrow does not afflict one who does not harbor self-conceit; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have attained this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਬਕਨਾ ਇਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kaa bakanaa iu jaanau jaise pavan jhulaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Know that the babbling of the faithless cynic is like wind passing by. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot paraadh achhaadio ihu man kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee ||
lines.translation: This mind is inundated by millions of sins - what can I say?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਠਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak deen saran aaio prabh sabh lekhaa rakhahu uthaaee ||4||3||
lines.translation: Nanak, Your humble servant has come to Your Sanctuary, God; please, erase all his accounts. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr lok grih banitaa maaiaa sanaba(n)dhehee ||
lines.translation: Children, spouses, men and women in one's household, are all bound by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਕੋ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kee baar ko kharaa na hosee sabh mithiaa asanehee ||1||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, none of them shall stand by you; their love is totally false. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਪੋਰਹੁ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: re nar kaahe paporahu dehee ||
lines.translation: O man, why do you pamper your body so?

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਡਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਧੂਮੁ ਬਾਦਰੋ ਇਕੁ ਭਾਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ood jaaigo dhoom baadaro ik bhaajahu raam sanehee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: It shall disperse like a cloud of smoke; vibrate upon the One, the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸੰਙਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਲ ਕੂਕਰ ਭਸਮੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teen sa(n)ngiaa kar dehee keenee jal kookar bhasamehee ||
lines.translation: There are three ways in which the body can be consumed - it can be thrown into water, given to the dogs, or cremated to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਆਮਰੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਬਿਸਰੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hoi aamaro grih mahi baithaa karan kaaran bisarohee ||2||
lines.translation: He considers himself to be immortal; he sits in his home, and forgets the Lord, the Cause of causes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਣੀਏ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗਿ ਪਰੋਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik bhaat kar maneee saaje kaachai taag parohee ||
lines.translation: In various ways, the Lord has fashioned the beads, and strung them on a slender thread.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਟਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: toot jaaigo soot baapure phir paachhai pachhutohee ||3||
lines.translation: The thread shall break, O wretched man, and then, you shall repent and regret. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin tum siraje siraj savaare tis dhiaavahu din rainehee ||
lines.translation: He created you, and after creating you, He adorned you - meditate on Him day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree mai satigur ot gahehee ||4||4||
lines.translation: God has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; I hold tight to the Support of the True Guru. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhetio vadabhaagee manahi bhaiaa paragaasaa ||
lines.translation: I met the True Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: koi na pahuchanahaaraa doojaa apune saahib kaa bharavaasaa ||1||
lines.translation: No one else can equal me, because I have the loving support of my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apune satigur kai balihaarai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai sukh paachhai sukh sahajaa ghar aana(n)d hamaarai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am at peace in this world, and I shall be in celestial peace in the next; my home is filled with bliss. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee karanaihaaraa soee khasam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Creator, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae gur charanee laage ik raam naam aadhaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: I have become fearless, attached to the Guru's feet; I take the Support of the Name of the One Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal darasan akaal moorat prabh hai bhee hovanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the Form of God is deathless; He is and shall always be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th lagaai apune jan raakhe apunee preet piaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: He hugs His humble servants close, and protects and preserves them; their love for Him is sweet to Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadee vadiaaee acharaj sobhaa kaaraj aaiaa raase ||
lines.translation: Great is His glorious greatness, and wondrous is His magnificence; through Him, all affairs are resolved.
